recommendations.title: `_format_default()` in `plan_tool/cli_reference.py` renders `--reuse` / `--no-reuse` as `off` in step 7's declared `docs
recommendations.body: `_format_default()` in `plan_tool/cli_reference.py` renders `--reuse` / `--no-reuse` as `off` in step 7's declared `docs/cli/reconcile-plan.md`, because its `BooleanOptionalAction` branch truthiness-tests the default and preempts the `default is None → "—"` branch below it. The cell reads as "`--no-reuse` is the default" while the same row's help text says "Default (unset): prompt interactively, auto-accepting under `--yes` / non-TTY stdin" — under non-TTY the unset default reuses an eligible fresh save and spends no claude call, the opposite of off. The same wrong cell appears for `--reuse` on `reconcile-code`, `run`, `detail`, and for `--reuse-audit` on `completeness-audit`
recommendations.suggested_action: order the `default is None` check ahead of the `BooleanOptionalAction` branch in `plan_tool/cli_reference.py:_format_default` so a tri-state renders `—`, then regenerate `docs/cli/` via `write_reference`
